text: The Director, Toronto Public Health will be giving a presentation on Building a Universal Student Food Program in Toronto. City Council, on its October 9 and 10, 2024 meeting, considered Item EX17.1 , and requested the City Manager, in coordination with the Medical Officer of Health, to report to the November 5, 2024 meeting of the Executive Committee on funding including intergovernmental contributions and operational considerations required to deliver student food programs by January 2025 in the schools that applied for the 2023/4 or 2024/5 school years, were deemed eligible, but were denied due to funding constraints, and make a presentation to the October 21, 2024, meeting of the City-School Boards Advisory Committee.
The City-School Boards Advisory Committee deferred the consideration of the item until its next meeting on February 26, 2025.
